Avery Liu: Heads-up: platform team plans to change sampling header semantics to include route and policy. this will affect telemetry and quota attribution. need quick SDK plan.
Sam Patel: Can you post the exact new header example?
Avery Liu: new header `x-rw-sample` -> stringified JSON: '{"route":"chat","policy":"console","rate":0.05}'. old boolean `x-rw-sample: true` accepted during transition.
Zoë Hart: Risk: customers using proxies or raw curl may not stringify correctly. recommend server accept both shapes and emit metric `sampling.header.form` with values `bool|json`.
Maya Singh: SDK approach: additive helpers only. py/ts/go add `setSampling({route:'chat', rate:0.05, source:'console'})`. default remains legacy. emit telemetry event `sdk.sampling.format_emitted`.
Sam Patel: We'll avoid breaking semver. Add unit tests for header encoding and an opt-in integration test that verifies server parses structured form.
Avery Liu: Devex: console toggle per-org, dashboard badge when structured sampling is in use, migration doc with expected log lines. Also include a quick rollback playbook.
ci-bot: rollout started for policy-service v3.20 -> canary. link: https://ci.redwood/d/2042 :rocket: 
Zoë Hart: Timeline: PRs this week, SDK patch next week, server accepts both forms for 60 days then WARN for 30 days. update support and product by EOD.
